articles.title: Stopped Daughter’s Kidnapping, Paid with Her Life: Mother Killed in Broad Daylight Attack in Meerut
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has been reported from Kapsad village under Sardhana police station limits in Meerut district, where a woman was brutally attacked while resisting the kidnapping of her 20-year-old daughter. The woman later succumbed to her injuries.

body.html:
A shocking incident has been reported from Kapsad village under Sardhana police station limits in Meerut district, where a woman was brutally attacked while resisting the kidnapping of her 20-year-old daughter. The woman later succumbed to her injuries.

According to police, the incident occurred on Thursday morning when Sunita was heading to the fields with her daughter. A youth from the same village allegedly tried to forcibly take the girl along with him. When Sunita objected and tried to stop him, the accused attacked her with a sharp-edged weapon, inflicting severe injuries.

Hearing her screams, villagers working nearby rushed to the spot, forcing the accused to flee. Sunita was first taken to the Sardhana Community Health Centre and later referred to a hospital in Meerut, where she remained on a ventilator. After battling for nearly seven hours, she died due to excessive blood loss.

Police have registered a case of attempted kidnapping and murder. The accused has been identified, and Meerut police have formed five special teams to arrest him. Search operations are underway using technical surveillance and local inputs. Police have increased patrolling in the area to ensure safety.

The incident has triggered fear and anger in the village, with residents demanding swift arrest and strict punishment for the accused.

articles.title: Woman Kidnapped in Broad Daylight Near SP’s Office in Bhilwara, Accused Try to Run Over Policeman
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking abduction incident was reported in Bhilwara on Wednesday evening when a young woman was forcibly dragged into a black Scorpio near the SP’s bungalow, barely 50 metres from the Superintendent of Police’s office.

body.html:
A shocking abduction incident was reported in Bhilwara on Wednesday evening when a young woman was forcibly dragged into a black Scorpio near the SP’s bungalow, barely 50 metres from the Superintendent of Police’s office.

According to police and family members, the incident occurred around 6 pm as the woman was returning after submitting an affidavit at the SP’s office, seeking protection from her parental family. The woman, who had recently entered into a court marriage and was living in a live-in relationship, had earlier complained of threats to her life from her maternal side.

As she was leaving, occupants of a black Scorpio stopped the vehicle mid-road and abducted her. Police personnel present at the spot tried to intervene. ASI Pratap Singh of the Special Branch attempted to stop the vehicle by standing in front of it, but the accused allegedly tried to run him over and fled. His mobile phone fell and broke during the incident, and he narrowly escaped. Two lawyers and a bike rider were also put at risk as the vehicle sped away, creating panic in the area.

The woman’s in-laws alleged that her parental family, unhappy with the court marriage, was behind the abduction.

Additional SP Paras Jain said police immediately set up blockades across the district. The black Scorpio has been seized, the woman has been traced and detained for questioning, and some accused have been taken into custody. A case has been registered and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: BJP Leader Seen Kicking Retired Soldier in Viral Lucknow Video, Police Say Incident Old
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing video allegedly showing BJP leader Chetan Bisht and a party associate assaulting a retired soldier has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread outrage. The incident reportedly took place on Kursi Road in Lucknow.

body.html:
A disturbing video allegedly showing BJP leader Chetan Bisht and a party associate assaulting a retired soldier has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread outrage. The incident reportedly took place on Kursi Road in Lucknow.

In the video, Chetan Bisht, identified as a BJP Metropolitan Coordinator, along with former Mandal president KP Singh, is seen allegedly knocking a retired soldier to the ground and repeatedly kicking him. Locals have identified the victim as Puran Singh Adhikari, a former soldier. The footage has sparked sharp reactions online, with many questioning the respect shown towards armed forces veterans.

The incident has fuelled debates on law and order and political accountability, with veterans’ groups and social media users demanding strict action. Many users termed the act “hooliganism” and said it reflected a sense of impunity among political figures.

Meanwhile, Lucknow Police clarified that no written complaint has been received so far at Gudamba police station. Police said preliminary verification suggests the incident occurred around one-and-a-half months ago during a wedding function. Authorities stated that facts are being verified and appropriate legal action will be taken once a formal complaint is filed.

body.html:
In another tragic road accident near Chevella, four youths lost their lives after a speeding car crashed into a divider and rammed into a tree at Mirjaguda in Rangareddy district.

The deceased have been identified as ICFAI University students — Suryateja, Nikhil, Sumit and Rohit. All four died on the spot due to the impact of the crash.

articles.title: Railway Caterer’s Throat Slit Near Station: Illicit Affair Angle Suspected #breakingnews
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 28-year-old woman was brutally murdered by slitting her throat in the Chapalaghatta area near the city railway station in the early hours of Tuesday, police said. The deceased has been identified as Uma, who worked in railway catering.

body.html:
A 28-year-old woman was brutally murdered by slitting her throat in the Chapalaghatta area near the city railway station in the early hours of Tuesday, police said.

The deceased has been identified as Uma, who worked in railway catering. Police said she was married 13 years ago and had three sons. She separated from her husband, a native of Andhra Pradesh, around five to six years ago. Two of her children were living with her, while one son stays with his father.

According to police sources, Uma was allegedly involved in an illicit relationship with a local youth. Investigators suspect that the man with whom she was in a relationship may be behind the murder.

Superintendent of Police S. Jahnavi, Additional SP G. Manjunath and DySP T. Manjunath visited the crime scene and conducted an inspection. Police said a case is being registered at Chittawadgi Police Station and further investigation is underway.
